name: find_doctor
description: Look up doctors. Call it as soon as you know the doctor's name; add city and specialty when the caller has said them. A found result gives clinic, address, phone, hours, languages, experience and rating. Without a name, pass city and specialty (and optionally day, time, language) to list who practices there, best rated first.

name.description: The doctor's name as the caller said it, e.g. 'Daria Munteanu' or 'paní doktorka Munteanu'. Omit to list doctors by city and specialty.

city.description: City or county in its Romanian spelling, e.g. 'Ploiesti', 'Cluj', 'Bucharest' (not 'Bukurešť'). Omit if unknown.

specialty.description: The caller's words mapped to one value, e.g. 'gynekolog' -> 'Obstetrics and Gynecology', 'ORL' or 'ušní' -> 'ENT', 'praktický lékař' -> 'Family Medicine'. Omit if unknown.

day.description: Only when listing: the weekday the caller wants a doctor, already resolved from "today", "tomorrow" or "next Monday". Omit otherwise.

time.description: Only with day: the hour the caller wants, 24-hour Romanian time as HH:MM, e.g. "14:30". Omit otherwise.

language.description: Only when listing: a language the doctor must speak. Omit otherwise.
